Details
About and safety
In AI mode the module takes over the phone app, silences the ringer and turns on Do Not Disturb, so a spare phone works best. To use the phone normally for a while, turn off the switch at the top.
To remove Myna completely, first turn off the switch at the top (back to a normal phone), then disable or remove the module in Magisk or KernelSU and restart the phone.
Laws on recording calls and on telling callers that they are talking to an AI differ from place to place. Following them is your responsibility.
